description: One publisher's source-health board (Quant Apparatus spec §8, Phase E). Two publishers emit this shape: the collector (health.json in the Blob store beside feed.json, every tick) and the nightly grading rollup (data/health/latest.json on the data branch). The board is READ-ONLY surveillance: it never edits the chain it describes — no auto-ungating, ever (gate changes are Isaac's or the Legion runner's). Statuses are spec §8's (ok / degraded / suspended / down / gated-off) plus three Phase E extensions the truth requires: 'not-a-link' (a chain entry that cannot serve real data — BetStack today; link is false), 'not-deployed' (built but not running — the sim service), and 'not-observed' (this publisher cannot see the thing from where it stands; recorded as such, never invented). `since` is an ISO timestamp when the publisher observed the change and a bare YYYY-MM-DD date when it is a standing-record day. `observedBy` says how the publisher knows: its own run ('collector'), the data branch's files ('data-branch'), or the apparatus build record ('standing-record').

board.description: Which board this record is: the collector's per-edition board or the nightly rollup.

flags.description: Plain-language, one-line flags for conditions that need Isaac's eyes (nightly rollup; the collector board emits an empty list — flagging is the nightly surface's job).

generatedAt.description: For the collector board: the feed edition this board describes (its boardSnapshotRef). For the rollup: the rollup's own generation time.

seams.description: Per-seam state (pick cards, prediction archive, ledger freshness, fit manifest, ...). Keys are publisher-defined seam names; every entry carries at least a status.

chain.description: The failover chain this source belongs to (Rule 10), or null when it is not a chain link.

link.description: Chain truth rule (spec §8): false means this entry does NOT count as a link in its chain — gated off, probe-failing, not deployed, or not in production. A chain's real depth counts only link:true entries.

reason.description: Why the source is in its current status, in plain language. Required in spirit for every non-ok status; null when ok.

title: SourceHealth
